method_notes: Pinned release binaries; serialized alternating pairs under caffeinate, with no builds, tests or profiling during accepted timing. Zero retry acceptance.
All142Lambda rows have at least3pairs; pilots and controls use21pairs. Screened slowdowns receive21pair confirmations. Highest pair-count capture retained; mixed-count aggregates descriptive.
All71LambdaJS rows use MIR:67short rows at least3pairs and four long JQ rows onepair with600second process timeouts. Long rows cannot exclude small regressions.
Frozen source and binary hashes, stable normalized stdout and available output oracles required. Canonical cross-language load/semantic differences remain explicit.
Instrumented whole-process call/COW counters, compiler/native snapshots and memory diagnostics are separate from accepted timing and do not assign CPU percentages.
Compiler pipeline totals include parse/AST/analysis and MIR finalize/link/native publication, charged under transpile; mir_gen zero is not missing generation. Native generation is not isolated.

comparison_matrix.comparison_limits: Both current ports time 15 frames and check77. Lambda times allocation/checksum too; JS setup is before the timer. Solver fusion/content versus reference swaps remain different. Historical one-frame JS results are not used.

comparison_matrix.comparison_limits: Canonical Lambda includes setup, 50x80 modifications and node-count validation; canonical JS times modifications after setup. Matched-seed/payload diagnostics are separate. Guarded native float consumers and resolved COW stores are in this candidate; required map copies remain.

comparison_matrix.name: brainfuck
comparison_matrix.comparison_limits: 10000 Hello World interpretations with 30000-cell tape. Lambda int payloads nominally initialize 2.4 GB versus JS Uint8Array 0.3 GB. This is a source/layout byte calculation, not a sampled CPU share. Dispatch and string/native arithmetic differences remain.

comparison_matrix.name: json_gen
comparison_matrix.comparison_limits: 10 x 1000 objects with seed42. Lambda floor and JS trunc differ in 750 objects; only the explicitly floor-aligned diagnostic establishes full cross-language content equality.

comparison_matrix.name: levenshtein
comparison_matrix.comparison_limits: Four distances 3,3,500,2. Canonical Lambda prints inside its timer; JS prints afterwards. Separate diagnostics place output after all timers. Row snapshots and complete min tuples are optimized.

comparison_matrix.name: puzzle
comparison_matrix.comparison_limits: 724 solutions on n=10. Plain-parameter recursive snapshots remain observable (S9.1.2); JS shares arrays and undoes mutations. Activation-local scalar snapshots retain logical copies but replace ordinary payload allocation on admitted int/bool shapes.

comparison_matrix.name: fft
comparison_matrix.comparison_limits: Canonical arrays have4096 floats, allzero; the plain Lambda parameter does not publish a transform. Separate returned nonzero diagnostics prove the kernel and snapshot contract. Mixed-domain arithmetic now uses native int-or-float branches; checked mixed-key COW stores remain.
